script_parts.opening: Namaste, Mumbai Curtains ji — main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon. Dekha ki aapka account pichle 10 mahine tak bahut achha chal raha tha, phir achanak last 30 days mein zero active days ho gaye — ek bhi login nahi. Isliye directly call kiya, kyunki yeh sudden change thoda concerning lag raha hai.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, seedha poochhna chahta hoon — kya koi specific wajah hai jiske wajah se platform use karna band ho gaya? Matlab koi technical issue tha, ya leads ki quality se disappointment tha, ya phir business mein koi doosri priority aa gayi thi?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important baat share karna chahta hoon — abhi aapke paas sirf 1 enquiry aayi hai last 30 days mein, aur us ek buyer ko bhi reply nahi mila, matlab reply rate zero percent hai. Jab buyer ko response nahi milta, toh woh doosre seller ke paas chala jaata hai — aur Coimbatore mein curtains ka demand tier Red hai, matlab competition already tight hai, toh har ek lead bahut valuable hai.
script_parts.action: Abhi is call pe, main aapka account open karta hoon — pehle us ek unanswered buyer lead ko saath mein dekhte hain aur ek quick reply draft karte hain, sirf 2 minute ka kaam hai. Saath hi aapka CQS score 73 hai jo 75 se thoda neeche hai, toh ek-do catalog field update karke usse bhi fix kar sakte hain abhi.
script_parts.close: Bhai, abhi koi bada commitment nahi maang raha — bas yeh ek reply bhej dete hain aur catalog mein woh ek-do fields update kar dete hain. Phir agle hafte ek short call karein aur dekhein ki koi enquiry aayi ya nahi — theek lagta hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, Mumbai Curtains ji — I'm calling from IndiaMART. I noticed your account was performing well for about 10 months, and then suddenly in the last 30 days there have been zero active days — not a single login. That sudden drop is what prompted me to call you directly today.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to ask you directly, bhai — is there a specific reason you stopped using the platform? Was it a technical issue, disappointment with lead quality, or did some other business priority come up that took your attention away?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's something important to consider — you've received only 1 enquiry in the last 30 days, and that one buyer got zero reply from your side, bringing your reply rate to 0%. When a buyer doesn't get a response, they simply move to the next seller. And with Coimbatore's curtain market already in the Red demand tier — meaning competition is tight — every single lead counts and cannot be left unanswered.
script_parts_en.action: Right now, on this call, let me open your account together with you — we'll look at that one unanswered buyer lead and draft a quick reply together, it'll take just 2 minutes. Also, your CQS score is 73, just slightly below the 75 threshold, so we can fix one or two catalog fields right now to push it above the benchmark.
script_parts_en.close: I'm not asking for any big commitment right now, bhai — let's just send that one reply and update those couple of catalog fields today. Then we can do a short follow-up call next week to check if any new enquiries came in — does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
